name: Automatic Image Optimizer & CDN by wpimg.io
author: wpimgio

sections.description:
Activate the plugin, and your images are optimized. That’s it.

Your images become significantly smaller without visible quality loss — meaning faster page loads for visitors.

No batch processing. No settings to configure. No waiting. Your existing images are optimized on-the-fly and delivered through Cloudflare’s global CDN (300+ locations worldwide).

Why wpimg.io?

  • Zero configuration — Works immediately with existing images
  • Non-destructive — Original images are never touched
  • Automatic format selection — AVIF, WebP, or original based on browser support
  • Global CDN — Fast delivery via Cloudflare edge network
  • Compatible — Works with most themes and page builders

How It Works

  1. Activate and accept Terms of Service
  2. Done — every image on your site is now optimized

Images are fetched from your server, optimized, and cached globally. Disable the plugin anytime and everything reverts instantly.

Supported Formats

Optimizes JPEG, PNG, WebP, and GIF images. Converts to AVIF or WebP for browsers that support them. GIF animations are preserved.

Free vs Pro

Free: 2,500 optimizations — enough for most sites.

Pro: Unlimited optimizations. Upgrade at wpimg.io/pricing.

External Service Notice

This plugin connects to the wpimg.io image optimization service. The service is powered by Cloudflare’s global CDN infrastructure.

When you activate this plugin:

  • Your site domain is registered with our service
  • Image requests are routed through our Cloudflare CDN
  • Original images are fetched from your server, optimized, and cached
  • Aggregated optimization statistics are collected (image counts, bytes saved)
  • Subscription status is checked periodically to ensure service availability

No personal data is collected. Only your site domain and optimization statistics are stored.

  • Service: wpimg.io
  • Terms of Service: wpimg.io/terms
  • Privacy Policy: wpimg.io/privacy
  • Support: support@wpimg.io
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard
  2. Search for “Automatic Image Optimizer & CDN by wpimg.io”
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. Go to Settings > Image Optimizer
  5. Accept the Terms of Service and click “Enable”

Done — your images are now optimized automatically.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.1 or higher
  • Images must be publicly accessible
sections.faq:
Are my original images modified?

No. Your original images are never touched. Optimization happens on-the-fly when images are requested. Disable the plugin and everything reverts instantly.

Do I need to re-upload my images?

No. The plugin works with your existing images automatically.

Will this slow down my site?

Smaller images load faster. The CDN also helps visitors far from your server load images quicker.

What happens if the service is unavailable?

The plugin includes automatic fallback. If our CDN is unavailable, images will be served directly from your origin server.

Does it work with page builders?

The plugin rewrites image URLs in the final HTML output, so it works with most page builders regardless of how they generate images. If you encounter issues, contact support.

Why don’t I see optimized images when logged in?

Image optimization is disabled for logged-in administrators to ensure the admin area and page builders work correctly. Log out or use an incognito window to see optimized images.

What about GIF animations?

Animated GIFs are preserved. They can be converted to WebP (which supports animation) but not AVIF (which doesn’t support animation in all browsers).
